entries.subject: math
entries.content: For ax² + bx + c = 0, where a ≠ 0, the roots are x = (-b ± √(b² - 4ac)) / (2a). The discriminant D = b² - 4ac tells the type of roots: D > 0 two distinct real roots; D = 0 equal real roots; D < 0 no real roots.

entries.subject: math
entries.content: In a right-angled triangle, a² + b² = c², where c is the hypotenuse (the side opposite the right angle).

entries.subject: math
entries.content: Circle area: A = πr². Circumference: C = 2πr = πd. Here r is radius and d is diameter.

entries.subject: math
entries.content: Percentage = (part ÷ whole) × 100%. To find p% of a quantity n, calculate (p/100) × n.

entries.subject: math
entries.content: Speed = distance ÷ time. Distance = speed × time. Time = distance ÷ speed. Keep units consistent.

entries.subject: math
entries.content: Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100, where P is principal, R is annual rate percent, and T is time in years. Amount = P + SI.

entries.subject: science
entries.content: Newton's second law: resultant force F = m × a, where mass m is in kilograms, acceleration a in m/s², and force F in newtons (N).

entries.subject: science
entries.content: Density = mass ÷ volume. Common units are kg/m³ or g/cm³.

entries.subject: science
entries.content: For a constant force in the direction of motion, work W = F × d. Power P = work ÷ time. Work is measured in joules (J); power in watts (W).

entries.subject: science
entries.content: Ohm's law: V = I × R, where voltage V is in volts, current I in amperes, and resistance R in ohms, for an ohmic conductor under constant physical conditions.

entries.subject: science
entries.content: Photosynthesis uses light energy to convert carbon dioxide and water into glucose and oxygen. Word equation: carbon dioxide + water → glucose + oxygen (in the presence of light and chlorophyll).

entries.subject: science
entries.content: Wave speed v = frequency f × wavelength λ, so v = fλ. Frequency is measured in hertz (Hz), wavelength in metres (m), and speed in m/s.
